translations.literal: On the gengshen day of the third month, Huoda went on leave. Soon died. On the jiwei day of the fourth month, Wei Yijie again became Left Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengshen day of the third month, Huoda went on leave. Soon died. On the jiwei day of the fourth month, Wei Yijie again became Left Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 苗登九月己卯左副都御史。尋遷。十月劉光麒左副都御史。十二月癸酉遷。

translations.literal: On the jimao day of the ninth month, Miao Deng: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. Soon was transferred. In the tenth month, Liu Guangqi: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief. On the guiyou day of the twelfth month, was transferred.

sentences.zh: 朱之弼五月遷。丙午楊時薦左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Zhu Zhibi was transferred. On the bingwu day, Yang Shijian: Left Deputy Censor-in-Chief.
